title: LR-193
author: Psalm 88 (87):3
snippet: Let my prayer come into your presence. Incline your ear to my cry for help, O Lord.

title: Responsorial Psalm - 22nd Sunday OT(A)
author: Psalm 63: 2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8
snippet: My soul is thirsting for you, O Lord my God.

title: Gospel Acclamation - 32nd Sunday OT(A)
author: Matthew 24:42a, 44
snippet: Stay awake and be ready! For you do not know on what day your Lord will come.

title: Christ the Lord
author: Sarah Hart / Robert Feduccia
snippet: Darkness hangs, the world is aching, Yearning for the coming light. In his rising, hope awaking, Love has come to steal the night. In our hearts true east we're facing, Toward the coming of our Lord. Morning rising, gloom now fleeing; Christ returned! His word is true!

title: Sanctuary
author: John W. Thompson, Randy Scruggs
snippet: Lord, prepare me to be a sanctuary; pure and holy; tried and true. With thanksgiving; I'll be a living Sanctuary for You.

title: The Lord is my Shepherd
author: Josh Blakesley
snippet: The Lord is my shepherd; there is nothing I shall want! The Lord is my shepherd; there is nothing I shall want!

title: The Beatitudes
author: Francesca LaRosa
snippet: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven. Blessed are those who mourn for they will be comforted. Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth. Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.

title: Set Me On Fire
author: St. Catherine of Sierra
snippet: Lord set me on fire with your love; a flame that nothing can contain. Burn every shadow deep within me. Let only your life remain.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
